cards.lore: Established the first systematic approach to trauma, treating the body as a structure to be repaired through observation and craft.
cards.power: The Empirical-Pounding. Moves medicine from Demon-Dances to recording Match-Data on trauma.

cards.lore: Separated medicine from religion; argued that epilepsy was a natural Brain-Glitch, not a divine curse.
cards.power: The Ethics-Anchor. Creates the Rules-of-the-Ring — the healer must serve the wrestler and do no harm.

cards.lore: Dominated medical thought so completely that for 1,000 years, no one dared to Dissect-the-Truth to see if his pig-based anatomy books matched the body.
cards.power: The Humoral-Lock. Defines the Four-Humor-Balance. His word becomes the undisputed manual.

cards.lore: Introduced Clinical-Trials and recognised that Bacteria-Punks could travel through air and water.
cards.power: The Logic-Synthesis. Merges Greek-Style with Persian-Insight into the ultimate Combat-Manual.

cards.lore: The birth of modern anatomy. Insisted the doctor must be the Observer, not just a reader of dusty books.
cards.power: The Dissection-Strike. Smashes Galen-Dogma by physically opening the Wrestler-Body.

cards.lore: Father of Toxicology. Moved medicine from Balancing-Humors to Targeted-Chemistry.
cards.power: The Chemical-Cure. Declares Life-Force is a series of Chemical-Matches needing Metal-and-Mineral allies.

cards.lore: Used math to prove the heart pumps more blood in an hour than the body weighs; blood is recycled, not consumed.
cards.power: The Circular-Flow. Proves the Blood-River moves in a Closed-Loop with the heart acting as a pump.

cards.lore: Father of Microbiology. Revealed the invisible enemies hidden from human eyes since the beginning.
cards.power: The Invisible-Reveal. Opens the Micro-Arena, proving a world of tiny wrestlers exists beneath the surface.

cards.lore: Birth of Immunology. A Weak-Enemy can train the Immune-Army to defeat a Lethal-Monster.
cards.power: The Armor-Transfer. Uses Cow-Pox-Gunk from immune milkmaids to give a Permanent-Shield.

cards.lore: The Semmelweis Reflex. Mocked for suggesting doctors were killing patients. He found the truth but lacked the Lore-of-Bacteria to explain it.
cards.power: The Silver-Clean. Realizes doctors carry Death-Particles; demands everyone Wash-with-Lime.

cards.lore: Mother of Nursing & Statistics. The Healing-Environment (Light, Air, Clean) is as powerful as any chemical ally.
cards.power: The Clean-Arena. Proves Grit-and-Gunk kill more than bullets. Uses Stat-Maps to force sanitation.

cards.lore: Applied Pasteur's Germ Theory to surgery. Proved Rot (Sepsis) is an invasion from the outside.
cards.power: The Antiseptic-Mist. Uses Carbolic-Acid-Rain to kill Bacteria-Punks before they enter the Wrestler-Body.

cards.lore: Realized Kind-Medicine leads to better Healing-Stats than Aggressive-Trauma-Treatment.
cards.power: The Gentle-Tie. Stops the Boiling-Oil-Torture; starts Tying-the-Pipes to stop bleeding without burning.

cards.lore: Birth of Anesthesia. Turned surgery from a 3-Minute-Sprint-of-Horror into a Precise-Technical-Art.
cards.power: The Pain-Mute. Puts the Wrestler into a Deep-Sleep, allowing the Blade-Brigade to work without screams.

cards.lore: Moved surgery from Barber-Shop-Craft to Academic-Science via Comparative-Anatomy.
cards.power: The Trial-by-Fire. Insists surgeons must be scientists, even infecting himself to study Match-Progression.

cards.lore: Established the Halstedian-Principles: gentle tissue handling, perfect hemostasis, absolute Arena-Sterility.
cards.power: The Sterile-Barrier. Introduces gloves to protect his Tag-Team-Partner, accidentally creating the Gold-Standard-of-Clean.

cards.lore: Father of Chemotherapy. Proved Chemistry can be a Sniper-Rifle instead of a Shotgun.
cards.power: The Targeted-Strike. Floods a Chemical-Dye that kills only the Syphilis-Spirochete without hurting the body.

cards.lore: Found the Secret-Weapon nature used to fight its own Micro-Wars, bringing it to the human arena.
cards.power: The Fungal-Shield. Discovers a Blue-Mold that dissolves Staph-Bacteria-Punks, the first true antibiotic.

cards.lore: Turned a Lethal-Waste-Match into a Chronic-Match. Sold the patent for $1 to ensure every wrestler got the key.
cards.power: The Sugar-Unlock. Extracts the Secret-Key (Insulin) so Diabetic-Wrestlers can use their Sugar-Tokens.

cards.lore: Birth of the modern pharmaceutical industry. A stable mass-producible Chemical-Ally for the common man.
cards.power: The Inflammation-Mute. Modifies Willow-Bark-Acid to be Stomach-Friendly, making a universal pain muter.

cards.lore: Refused to patent it, calling it a Gift to Humanity. Opened the era of Diagnostic-Inference.
cards.power: The Transparent-Wrestler. Discovers New-Light that passes through flesh but stops at bone, revealing Inside-Secrets without a cut.

cards.lore: Created Petites Curies (Mobile X-ray units) for WWI, bringing Shadow-Catching to the front lines.
cards.power: The Atomic-Fire. Discovers elements emitting Constant-Energy used to Burn-the-Tumor-Miners from the inside.

cards.lore: Transformed imaging from a Flat-Picture into a Volumetric-Map. Created the Donut of Truth.
cards.power: The 3D-Reconstruction. Uses Computer-Math to turn hundreds of X-ray-Shadows into a sliceable 3D-Virtual-Wrestler.

cards.lore: Magnetic Resonance Imaging. Figured out how to turn Magnetic-Signals into Pictures-of-the-Mind.
cards.power: The Resonance-Map. Uses Massive-Magnets to make Water-Protons dance, revealing soft-tissue secrets.

cards.lore: Father of Genetics. Heredity is not a Blending-of-Blood, but a Shuffle-of-Information-Packets.
cards.power: The Blueprint-Logic. Discovers the Invisible-Rules of how Traits pass from Coach to Rookie.

cards.lore: Found the Physical-Storage of the Source-Code. Unlocked the language of the A, T, C, G wrestlers.
cards.power: The Master-Scroll. Reveal the Code-of-Life is a Twisted-Ladder that can unzip and Copy-Itself.

cards.lore: Made Genetic-Testing fast and cheap. Allows us to find a Single-Virus-Punk in an ocean of blood.
cards.power: The DNA-Megaphone. Takes a Single-Tiny-Code-Scrap and copies it millions of times until the Enemy-Name is loud.

cards.lore: Era of Programmable-Medicine. We can now Edit-the-Wrestler to fix the Source-Code-Errors of the past.
cards.power: The Genetic-Scissors. Reaches into the Master-Scroll to Cut-out-a-Glitch, replacing it with a Healthy-Code-Line.

cards.lore: Father of Epidemiology. Disease-Matches are won by Mapping-the-Data and Removing-the-Source.
cards.power: The Source-Finder. Ignores Miasma-Ghost-Theory; maps Match-Deaths until they point to a single dirty pump.

cards.lore: Could you patent the sun? Prioritized Global-Arena-Safety over personal Token-Profit.
cards.power: The Iron-Lung-Breaker. Creates a shield stopping the Polio-Paralyzer from taking over Muscle-Engines.

cards.lore: Father of Emergency Medicine. Invented Triage, treating the Most-Injured first, regardless of rank or side.
cards.power: The Rapid-Extraction. Uses Flying-Ambulances to pull wounded out of the Battlefield-Arena mid-fight.

cards.lore: Cleaned the Arena-Environment, proving public health is about controlling the environment as much as the patient.
cards.power: The Vector-Slayer. Realizes the antagonist isn't swamp-gas, but the Mosquito-Drone carrying the incursion.

cards.lore: Proved the Body-Arena is modular. We can Swap-the-Parts to continue the Match-of-Life.
cards.power: The Total-Engine-Swap. Takes a Healthy-Engine from a fallen wrestler and installs it into a new arena.

cards.lore: Unlocked the Secret-of-Conception, giving the Gift-of-Life to those whose natural arenas were closed.
cards.power: The External-Creation. Starts the Creation-Match in a Glass-Disk when biological pipes are blocked, tagging the mother in later.

cards.lore: Bridged Ancient-Wisdom and Modern-Science, proving past Arena-Secrets are still powerful.
cards.power: The Herbal-Recall. Searches Ancient-Chinese-Scrolls to find a Plant-Weapon that kills malaria when modern drugs fail.

cards.lore: Turned the body into a Vaccine-Factory. Hacked Protein-Translation to win the Pandemic-Brawl.
cards.power: The Instructions-Beam. Seeds a Messenger-Scroll telling the wrestler's own cells how to build the shield.

cards.lore: The bridge between Medieval-Theology and Rational-Clinical-Observation, treating the Whole-Human.
cards.power: The Soul-and-Body-Merge. Teaches that the Wrestler's Mind must be healthy for the body to heal; diet over aggressive bleeding.

cards.lore: Combined Mystical-Vision with Practical-Botany, keeping the Flame-of-Knowledge alive in monasteries.
cards.power: The Green-Pharmacy. Maps the Healing-Power of hundreds of plants and stones during a time of Spiritual-Daze.

cards.lore: First to Stitch-the-Inside with dissolving Catgut, allowing for Deep-Arena-Repairs.
cards.power: The Tool-Maker. Invents the scalpel and forceps still used today, turning Barbaric-Cutting into precision surgery.

cards.lore: The Prophet-of-the-Infection. Guessed the Match-Rules of contagion centuries early.
cards.power: The Parasite-Finder. Predicts disease is carried by Invisible-Seeds on clothing and air long before microscopes.

cards.lore: Standardized medical education, moving it into the University-and-Lab away from Apprentice-Guesswork.
cards.power: The Rigor-Wall. Shuts down training arenas lacking Scientific-Manuals, creating the Modern-Doctor-Knights.

cards.lore: The Global-Safety-Net. Ensures Health-Stats are tracked and Vaccine-Shields delivered globally.
cards.power: The Arena-Orchestrator. Coordinates the Match-Plan for the entire world, fighting Pandemic-Monsters across borders.

cards.lore: He who studies without patients does not go to sea at all. The creator of modern clinical rounds.
cards.power: The Clinical-Closeness. Pulls Student-Rookies out of the lecture hall, forcing them to Listen-to-the-Patient.

cards.lore: Proved humanity must exist even in combat chaos. Turned Medical-Mercy into Global-Law.
cards.power: The Mercy-Sanctuary. A Neutral-Symbol protecting healers in the War-Arena, ensuring the wounded are always treated.

cards.lore: Allowed us to hear the Internal-Soundtrack of the heart and lungs for the first time.
cards.power: The Stetho-Inference. Uses a rolled paper tube to Hear-the-Valve-Clicks, inventing internal sound tracking.

cards.lore: Birth of Electrocardiography. Gave the Electrical-Ghost of the heart a physical body we could study.
cards.power: The Rhythe-Writer. Records the Electrical-Signals of the heart-engine onto a Paper-Scroll.

cards.lore: Transformed neonatal care. Ensured no baby wrestler was ignored in the critical first minutes of life.
cards.power: The First-Minute-Scan. A 5-point check to see if the Newborn-Rookie is ready for the arena or needs a jumpstart.

cards.lore: The experimental pioneer who proved Nuclear Magnetic Resonance could find hidden monsters in the body.
cards.power: The Molecular-Scanner. Builds a Magnetic-Bunker to see if Cancer-Miners have different water-signals than healthy cells.

cards.lore: The ethical rebirth after the darkest Heel-Turn in history. Put the Human-Soul back into the science machine.
cards.power: The Research-Shield. Declares Human-Wrestlers must never be forced into a match and must give voluntary consent.

cards.lore: The tragic reminder that Science-without-Ethics is a monster. Directly led to the Belmont protections.
cards.power: The Trust-Destroyer. A dark chapter where doctors hid the cure to watch wrestlers suffer, creating a permanent trust gap.

cards.lore: Forced the creation of IRB-Gatekeepers to ensure every match plan is checked for morality before it starts.
cards.power: The Conscience-Call. Publishes a List-of-Shame, showing elite arenas breaking shields for Data-Tokens.

cards.lore: The Universal-Armor of the human subject. The moral code guiding every research match in the modern world.
cards.power: The Triple-Shield. Sets final rules: respect the wrestler, do good, treat fairly.

cards.lore: Respect the ancestors, but never stop dissecting the dogma! Stay fluffy!
cards.power: The Wisdom-Orchestrator

cards.lore: Combo Play: Use the Empirical-Method to demand Evidence before draining the wrestler! (Evidence vs. Blood-letting).
cards.power: Quest: A 13th-century wrestler has a fever. The Galen-Manual demands Blood-Letting.

cards.lore: Combo Play: Combine Lister's Antiseptic-Mist with Pasteur's Germ-Theory to prove the Referees wrong and win the arena!
cards.power: Quest: 19th-century mothers are dying. Semmelweis screams about Dirty-Hands, but Referees mock him.

cards.lore: Combo Play: Combine the Double-Helix-Scroll (Watson/Crick) with Genetic-Scissors (Doudna) to Edit the Code and save the match!
cards.power: Quest: A 21st-century child has a Genetic-Glitch that will crash their muscle-engine.

title: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
